create_OperatorConfig: create an OperatorConfig dataclass instance with default LLM and Jinja prompt template settings
validate_OperatorConfig: validate an OperatorConfig instance and recursively validate all nested config fields
configure_OperatorConfig_for_debug: configure an OperatorConfig instance for debug mode by recursively calling configure_for_debug on nested fields
hash_OperatorConfig: compute a SHA-224 hash of an OperatorConfig instance excluding fields marked exclude_from_hash
customize_OperatorConfig_prompt_template: customize the system, init user, and user message Jinja prompt templates on an OperatorConfig
